limitations: Full recorded sample window is our reduction recipe, not the authors' settling-time processing or inference pipeline.
Exact binary64 fractions describe digitized voltage arithmetic, not exact physical means or probabilities.

No uncertainty estimator, covariance, acceptance threshold, fit, automatic nuisance correction, or Born-rule violation inference. Optional supplied deterministic epsilon bounds support conditional scalar transfer only.

Authors attribute nonzero kappa to shutter crosstalk; independent detector-nonlinearity measurements yield Peres DeltaF correction estimates, not a transferable epsilon-voltage bound. These effects are not corrected here.
Sample times are calendar components, not exposure durations or trigger counts.
Housing temperature channel remains native volts; no conversion to degrees Celsius.
30°C housing telemetry contains one recorded NaN at record 1167, cycle 146; retained explicitly, unused in reduction. 23°C has no temperature channel.
A common positive affine response preserves kappa and a negative gain flips its sign; neither response convention is inferred from these files.
No candidate family, primitive verdict, proof-status upgrade, or completed QM derivation.

nuisance_evidence.sampling_definition: s=ehat-mu; mu is expectation of the identical acquisition/reduction estimator under a supplied ensemble
nuisance_evidence.bias_definition: b=mu-q; q is corresponding ideal fixed-path epsilon
nuisance_evidence.eligibility_boundary: Declared deterministic bounds must bind run, raw SHA256 and recipe SHA256 and hold simultaneously; software cannot certify their truth. Same-data provenance alone is not disqualifying; explicit dependence on the tested null is.

items.evidence: Independent detector-nonlinearity measurement is reported through Peres DeltaF correction estimates -4.7e-5 and -9.4e-5; no epsilon-voltage bound, transfer curve or uncertainty artifact is supplied.

items.locator: Section 5.4 equations 14-16, Table 3; Appendix B equations 31 and 36
items.evidence: Delta phi_DH is inferred from the same measured epsilon under the Born/null assumption and corrected phases, selecting the smaller of two roots. Values -0.017 and -0.014 rad are not independent calibration and cannot bound a test of that null.
The analysis assumes Gaussian independent power/phase fluctuations with moments obtained from the tested data. SD and SEM are not deterministic signed-error bounds.
Reported SEM is autocorrelation-corrected, but the implemented lag/window algorithm is unavailable; this replay implements neither SEM nor an inferred algorithm.
Leakage tau estimates 2.20(2)e-4 and 2.707(4)e-4 use main data and additional assumptions with unknown shutter phase; these are not independent epsilon-bias intervals.
The 23-degree DeltaF_CT entry is -6.4e-3 in Table 4 versus -9.0e-3 in Table 3. No reconciled correction budget or epsilon transfer is manufactured.
The archive contains two main HDF5 runs and a contrast HDF5 file, but no detector-calibration artifact or author analysis code.
